title: Development inventory
availability_expired: Public unit availability has reverted to unconfirmed.
unsaved: Save your edits before reviewing or publishing this revision.

errors.access: Sign in with an Admin account to manage development inventory.
errors.missing: Development inventory is available for active listings offered for sale.
errors.conflict: The saved inventory changed. Reload it to check the current revision before trying again.
errors.validation: Check the required names, unit codes, source reference, dates, prices and floor plan permissions.
errors.too_large: This inventory is too large to save. Reduce the draft size and try again.
errors.uncertain: The inventory request could not be verified. Reload saved inventory before trying again.

review.label: Review revision
review.description: Mark revision {{revision}} as reviewed after checking the developer source, availability dates and permission for any public floor plans.

publish.label: Publish revision
publish.description: Publish revision {{revision}} on the property page. The public availability follows its verification dates.

withdraw.label: Withdraw inventory
withdraw.description: Remove development inventory from the public property page. The saved revision remains available here.
